content_zh:
这一天之中，他算是东躲西藏的，越来越多的张家的人都加入了追捕的行列之中了，张家的弟子在这一带的磨练的，虽然他们不知道叶希文的样子，凡是见过叶希文的人，都被叶希文杀死了，但是这不妨碍他们对叶希文的追捕，凡是看过去有嫌疑的，都会被他们抓住杀死。
宁杀错三千，不放过一个！
追逐了一天，也没有丝毫要停止的意思，也是，叶希文宰了两位张家的少主，张家能不震怒么，而且随着时间的推移，出现的高手会越来越多，越来越强。
必须要想个办法摆脱他们，或者让他们元气大伤！
“吼！”突然一阵持续不断的兽吼传来，好似猿猴的啼叫被放大了无数倍。
不知道多少暴猿的声音在回荡，响彻一片天际。
叶希文顿时站了起来，飞跃到另外一棵大树上，迅速朝着声音发来的地方飞掠而去。
远远的，叶希文就看到，一百多只的巨猿，只见这些巨猿全身披覆着银白色的毛发，约莫着两米多高，凶面獠牙，极是凶恶。
铁背银猿群！
猿类妖兽在青峰山中并不少见，有多个族群，其中铁背银猿算是蛮有名的一种，这些暴猿每一头都是力大无穷，成年的铁背银猿就能有超过四虎之力，不下于后天五重的武者，能生撕虎豹，身强体壮，如钢筋一般，刀枪难入。
在巨猿群一片银白色之中，一只金黄色的暴猿傲然立于树冠之上，身高近三米，比之一般银色巨猿还要高上许多。
这是铁背银猿王，一股气势极为可怕，按照人类的划分方法，绝对超过后天八重，力大无穷。
一百多只的铁背银猿，从规模来说已经算是不小的一个族群了。
叶希文顿时有了一个主意，将张家的人引过来，铁背银猿是一种非常看重地盘的生物，凡是试图靠近他们地盘的生物，都会被视为挑衅，然后撕裂掉。
到时候叶希文就可以浑水摸鱼的逃掉。
打定了主意之后，叶希文就转身，朝着张家的队伍的方向走去。
————————
丛林之中，一队张家的武者正仔细的搜寻着叶希文的经过的痕迹，试图找到些什么，现在高层已经下令，要将叶希文抓住，杀死，宁杀错不放过。
突然，一颗树顶上，一道黑影蹿了下来，‘轰隆隆’一阵轰隆隆的雷暴声，一只大手当空拍了下来。
“嘭！”队伍中的一个武者立时毙命。

“这个人就是杀死我们张家许多人的凶手，抓住他！”顿时有武者认出了叶希文喝道。
叶希文击毙了一个武者之后，转身就走，后面张家的武者立刻追了过来。
叶希文几个起跃之间就没入了树林之中，后面追来的张家的高手越来越多，浩浩荡荡，数十人。
“追，今天一定要追到这个凶手！”
“杀死他，碎尸万段，连我们张家的人都敢动！”
“杀，为了少主报仇！”
“小子，给我死来！”一声爆喝，那个刀疤脸中年男子加入了追杀叶希文的行列。
叶希文能感觉到后面许多股带着强大杀意的气息，顿时冷笑一声，来吧，来的越多，他就越有机会浑水摸鱼。
身后的追兵越来越近，同时铁背银猿族群的领地也是近在眼前，叶希文从地上抓起一块大石头，朝着远处的一头铁背银猿扔去。
紧接着叶希文顿时一个鱼跃，窜进了树丛之中，匍匐在地上，隐蔽了全部的气息。
“嘭！”那一块大石头直接将那一头铁背银猿给砸晕了过去，叶希文的力量何等的大，以千斤来计算，也就是铁背银猿钢筋铁骨，换了一般的妖兽，就这一猛子的砸过去，都能让他脑袋裂开。
“吼！”
“吼！”
“吼！”
铁背银猿群，怒了，有人居然敢入侵他们的领地，进攻他们的族群，纷纷仰天怒吼，双手敲打着胸膛，凶气滔天。
铁背银猿群以前所未有的速度在那头猿王的带领下，朝着叶希文刚才的方向冲了过来，这些肌肉发达的大块头在树上的速度极快，手臂挂在树枝之上，换手之间，就飞跃好几米的距离。

content_en:
During this day, he was hiding here and there, and more and more people from the Zhang family joined the hunt. The disciples of the Zhang family were trained in this area. Although they did not know Ye Xiwen's appearance, everyone who had seen Ye Xiwen was killed by Ye Xiwen, but this did not hinder their pursuit of Ye Xiwen. Anyone who looked suspicious would be caught and killed by them.
I would rather kill three thousand by mistake than let one go!
After chasing for a day, there was no intention to stop. Also, Ye Xiwen killed two young masters of the Zhang family. How could the Zhang family not be furious? And as time goes by, more and more masters will appear, becoming stronger and stronger.
We must find a way to get rid of them, or make them severely damaged!
"Roar!" Suddenly a continuous roar came, as if the ape's cry was amplified countless times.
The voices of countless violent apes were echoing throughout the sky.
Ye Xiwen immediately stood up, jumped to another big tree, and quickly flew towards the place where the sound came from.
From a distance, Ye Xiwen saw more than a hundred giant apes. These giant apes were covered in silver-white hair, about two meters tall, with fierce faces and fangs, and they were extremely vicious.
A group of iron-backed silver apes!
Ape-like monsters are not uncommon in Qingfeng Mountain. There are many groups, among which the Iron-backed Silver Ape is quite famous. Each of these violent apes is extremely powerful. An adult Iron-backed Silver Ape can have the strength of more than four tigers, and is no less than a fifth-level acquired warrior. It can tear apart tigers and leopards, and its body is as strong as a steel bar, making it difficult for swords and guns to penetrate.
Among the silvery white giant apes, a golden violent ape stood proudly on the canopy of the tree. It was nearly three meters tall, much taller than the average silver giant ape.
This is the Iron-backed Silver Ape King. His aura is extremely terrifying. According to human classification methods, it definitely exceeds the acquired eighth level and is extremely powerful.
There are more than a hundred Iron-backed Silver Apes, which is already a large group in terms of size.
Ye Xiwen suddenly had an idea and lured people from the Zhang family over. The Iron-backed Silver Ape was a creature that valued its territory very much. Any creature that tried to get close to their territory would be considered a provocation and then torn apart.
At that time, Ye Xiwen could fish in troubled waters and escape.
After making up his mind, Ye Xiwen turned around and walked in the direction of the Zhang family's team.
————————
In the jungle, a group of Zhang family warriors were carefully searching for traces of Ye Xiwen's passing, trying to find something. Now the top management has given orders to capture and kill Ye Xiwen. They would rather kill the wrong person than let him go.
Suddenly, a black shadow jumped down from the top of a tree. There was a thunderstorm and a big hand shot it down from the air.
"Bang!" A warrior in the team died immediately.
"This man is the murderer of many members of our Zhang family, catch him!" A warrior immediately recognized Ye Xiwen and shouted.
After Ye Xiwen killed a warrior, he turned around and left. The warriors from the Zhang family immediately chased after him.
Ye Xiwen disappeared into the woods in a few leaps. More and more masters from the Zhang family were chasing him, dozens of them.
"Chase, we must catch this murderer today!"
"Kill him and break his body into thousands of pieces. Even members of our Zhang family dare to touch him!"
"Kill, take revenge for the young master!"
"Boy, die!" shouted loudly, and the scar-faced middle-aged man joined the pursuit of Ye Xiwen.
Ye Xiwen could feel many auras with strong murderous intent behind him, and immediately sneered, come on, the more people come, the more opportunities he has to fish in troubled waters.
The pursuers behind him were getting closer and closer, and at the same time, the territory of the Iron-backed Silver Ape group was also in front of him. Ye Xiwen grabbed a big stone from the ground and threw it towards an Iron-backed Silver Ape in the distance.
Immediately afterwards, Ye Xiwen suddenly jumped into the woods and crawled on the ground, hiding all his energy.interest.
"Bang!" The big stone knocked the Iron-backed Silver Ape unconscious. Ye Xiwen's strength was so great. Calculated in kilograms, the Iron-backed Silver Ape had steel and iron bones. If it were an ordinary monster, just this violent smash would have cracked his head.
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
The iron-backed silver apes were angry. Someone dared to invade their territory and attack their tribe. They roared to the sky and beat their chests with both hands, with overwhelming ferocity.
Led by the ape king, the group of iron-backed silver apes rushed towards Ye Xiwen's direction at an unprecedented speed. These muscular hunks were moving extremely fast on the trees. Their arms were hanging on the branches, and they could leap several meters between changing hands.
